item_short_desc: Rothco's ear protection set, comprising two ultra-soft hypoallergenic silicone earplugs designed for maximum comfort and protection. With a noise reduction rating of 25 decibels, these earplugs offer  defense against loud environments. Their three ultra-thin flanges ensure a snug fit while minimizing pressure on the inner ear. Plus, their reusable design allows for easy maintenance by simply washing in warm, soapy water, without compromising on flexibility or protective capabilities.
